title: sip two C nineteen, clopidogrel, and proton pump inhibitors

segs.text: Section twelve. sip two C nineteen. This liver enzyme metabolizes slightly acidic drugs: proton pump inhibitors, which lower stomach acid, and fluoxetine, sertraline and diazepam. Patients are grouped by activity, from poor metabolizers, the least, through intermediate and extensive, to ultrarapid.

Star two and star three are single base changes that create a premature stop codon: the protein is too short to work, and no active enzyme is made. Star seventeen does the opposite. Its change sits upstream of the gene, where the machinery that expresses the gene binds, so more enzyme is made and activity rises. Star seventeen does not change the enzyme's shape, and it is not extra gene copies.

Clopidogrel, which stops platelets sticking together, is a prodrug that two C nineteen helps activate, so both directions harm. A star two or star three carrier makes too little active drug and the platelets stay sticky: therapeutic failure. A star seventeen carrier makes too much and is over anticoagulated. She said clopidogrel is a drug for which we should be genotyping people for two C nineteen status.

With proton pump inhibitors, being a poor metabolizer helps. Two C nineteen clears these drugs, so low activity keeps the level higher, which suppresses more acid, raises stomach p H, and gives a better cure rate, and it is safe because their therapeutic index is very wide. A two thousand four study by Furuta and colleagues gave lansoprazole and plotted three panels by phenotype: total exposure, area under the curve, stomach p H over twenty four hours, and cure rate. Poor metabolizers had the highest of all three.

The assigned reading is a different paper, Furuta and colleagues, nineteen ninety eight. Patients took omeprazole plus the antibiotic amoxicillin to cure H pylori, a stomach infection. The less two C nineteen activity, the higher the cure rate: rapid metabolizers twenty eight point six percent, intermediate sixty percent, poor metabolizers, who make no active enzyme, one hundred percent. Poor metabolizers also had more ulcer healing.

The same high levels harm with the other substrates: a poor metabolizer on a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor, fluoxetine or sertraline, or on diazepam has more adverse drug responses, including more sedation with diazepam. The poor metabolizer benefits only when the therapeutic index is wide.
